entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You're in the presence of our master.[n]Stand up straight!

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The bonds that you have reeled in are[n]quite intriguing...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: In other words, they all have been[n]unfairly labeled by society and are[n]standing up against such fates.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Have you noticed? They seem to have[n]influenced you.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* These picaresque dissidents[n]of society... Deepen your bonds with[n]them.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Those will become the strength behind[n]your rehabilitation... I look forward to it.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I shall grant you an ability befitting of[n]your newfound growth. Consider it a gift.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: May you continue devoting yourself[n]to further rehabilitation.
I feel like my bond with Igor[n]is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок з Ігорем[n]стає глибшим...
